title: Migrate dynamic route params from 15 compatibility to 16
businessContext: Review a focused Next.js application change before it reaches production. The proposed file below contains the defect or unsupported assumption; external application services, where imported, are integration boundaries.
problemStatement: Review the proposed app/products/[id]/page.tsx change. Identify the incorrect framework assumption, propose a minimal corrected implementation, and provide evidence for the selected version scope and its 15/16 differences. Explain the interview variation after solving the base task. This is a framework code review: actual rendering, routing and cache behavior must be checked in a real Next.js build, not a browser function sandbox.
constraints: Preserve the stated user behavior and keep trust boundaries explicit.
Use the selected version’s documented API; do not suppress build/type failures to hide the defect.
Build a dynamic route and directly request /products/abc.
Verify generated route types accept the promised params signature.
Test a missing resource separately from an invalid identifier.
candidateTasks: Add actionable line-level review comments explaining impact and correction.
Write the corrected file in the local IDE copy; split annotated companion files where instructed.
Record actual build/request/navigation evidence against the acceptance checks and compare version notes.
hints: Update the route-prop type and implementation together.
Build a dynamic route and directly request /products/abc.
alternativeApproaches: Their dynamic params are also asynchronous in the migration. Update page, layout, route and metadata consumers consistently; next typegen can help validate generated contracts on supported versions.
commonMistakes: Verifying only next dev when the behavior depends on production rendering or bundling.
Treating a visible UI state, matcher or TypeScript type as a substitute for server-side validation and authorization.

nextjsPractice.next15: Next.js 15 introduces promised params with temporary synchronous compatibility. Migrate callers and types instead of relying on that compatibility.
nextjsPractice.next16: Synchronous params access is removed. Await the promise, or unwrap with React use in an appropriate synchronous component.
